Job Brief We are looking for a QA Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software through both manual and automated testing. You should have hands-on experience testing web and mobile applications, writing automation scripts, and identifying issues before they reach production. Quality Assurance: Participate in requirement reviews, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies to ensure quality throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). Continuous Improvement: Contribute to improving test processes, automation coverage, and overall product quality through proactive feedback and collaboration. Requirements Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Manual and Automation Testing. Manual Testing: Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC. Experience in preparing test cases, executing test plans, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, and exploratory testing. Automation Skills: Hands-on experience with Python , Selenium WebDriver , and Playwright . Ability to develop and maintain automation scripts. Mobile Testing: Experience testing Flutter-based mobile applications on Android and iOS platforms. Bug Management: Hands-on experience using Jira for defect tracking, bug lifecycle management, and verification. Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to identify root causes and collaborate effectively with development teams. Communication: Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional Agile teams. Work Environment: Ability to work under pressure, meet project deadlines, manage multiple tasks, and work flexible hours when required.

title: QA Engineer — Manual & Automated Testing
description: About the role We build websites, web applications, and AI-powered business tools. We’re looking for a QA Engineer to test these products thoroughly, identify issues, and work closely with our developers to get them resolved. You will own the testing cycle: test features, report bugs, coordinate fixes, retest, and check that changes haven’t broken existing functionality. This is a hands-on role for someone who is systematic, persistent, and comfortable working with a fast-moving development team. What you’ll do Test new features and existing functionality across our websites and applications. Check complete user journeys, including sign-up, login, forms, payments, bookings, and integrations. Test across desktop, mobile, and different browsers. Find edge cases, error states, and issues that users might encounter. Document bugs with clear reproduction steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots, or recordings. Work with developers to clarify issues, track fixes, and flag blockers. Retest fixes and perform regression testing to identify unintended problems. Maintain practical test cases, checklists, and an organised bug backlog. Build and maintain automated tests for critical workflows using tools such as Playwright or Cypress. Give the team a clear view of release readiness and unresolved issues. What we’re looking for Hands-on experience testing websites and web applications. Strong manual testing skills and a structured approach to finding problems. Experience with functional, regression, integration, and cross-browser testing. Ability to write clear, reproducible bug reports. Familiarity with browser developer tools, console errors, and network requests. Experience with—or the ability to build—automated tests using Playwright, Cypress, or a similar tool. Basic understanding of APIs and tools such as Postman. Clear communication and the ability to follow issues through to resolution. Ownership: you verify that a fix works and check its impact on related features. Nice to have Experience testing AI applications, chatbots, voice agents, or business automations. Familiarity with Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, and third-party integrations. Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to create and maintain tests. Basic JavaScript or Python skills. What success looks like Critical user journeys are tested consistently. Bugs are reported clearly and followed through to a verified fix. Releases introduce fewer recurring issues. Automated tests provide reliable coverage of important workflows. The team knows what is ready to ship and what still needs attention ﻿ How to apply Share your CV and a brief example of a difficult bug you found, how you documented it, and how you verified the fix. Include any relevant test plans, sample bug reports, or automation projects you can share.

title: Quality Engineer
description: Position Overview The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the delivery of high‑quality software through a combination of manual and automated testing practices. This role works closely with Development, Product, DevOps, and Delivery teams to validate functionality, improve test coverage, identify defects early, and continuously enhance the quality of products and platforms. The QE contributes to test strategy, builds automation frameworks, and helps foster a culture of quality throughout the engineering organization. Participate in story refinement to ensure testability and clear acceptance criteria. Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and regression suites. Contribute to the overall QA strategy, including test coverage goals, automation priorities, and risk-based testing. Functional & Non‑Functional Testing Implement functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing. Validate API responses, UI behaviour, workflows, and data integrity across environments. Perform non‑functional testing such as performance, usability, or basic security validation as needed. Ensure defects are clearly documented, reproducible, and communicated effectively. Test Automation Development Design, build, and maintain automated test suites using modern automation frameworks. Create and execute automated regression tests for UI, API, and service layers. Partner with Developers and DevOps to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure automation provides meaningful value by reducing manual effort and enabling early defect detection. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Work closely with Developers to understand architecture, code changes, and risk areas.
